commands.name: project.read
commands.description: Read the project: size, aspect, media, tracks and clips with their timeline times (seconds).

commands.name: project.aspect
commands.description: Set the canvas aspect: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.

commands.name: project.mode
commands.description: Switch between quick mode (CapCut-style) and pro mode (multitrack). Both edit the same project.

commands.name: clip.add
commands.description: Put an imported media item on the timeline. With no start it goes at the end of the track (quick mode).

commands.name: clip.insert
commands.description: Insert a source range of a media file at a timeline time: a clip under that time splits and later clips move along (on the main track). in and out are source seconds.

trackId.description: Track (default: main or the first audio track)

commands.name: clip.split
commands.description: Split a clip at a timeline time (seconds).

commands.name: clip.trim
commands.description: Move a clip edge. edge "start" or "end"; to is the new timeline time in seconds.

commands.name: clip.remove
commands.description: Delete a clip. On the main track later clips close the gap.

ripple.description: Close the gap (default: the track decides)

commands.name: clip.move
commands.description: Move a clip to a new start time and optionally another track of the same kind.

commands.name: clip.set
commands.description: Change clip properties: volume (0–2), fadeIn, fadeOut, speed (0.25–4), opacity, scale, x, y, rotation, fit (fit|fill|blur), look (none|vivid|warm|cool|mono|fade|noir|sunset), blend (normal|multiply|screen|overlay|darken|lighten|difference|color-dodge|soft-light), filters {brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature} each -1..1, reverse (true plays the clip backwards), transitionIn {type: crossfade|fade|wipe|slide, duration, dir: right|left for wipe and slide} or null, text, style, muted.

commands.name: text.add
commands.description: Add a text overlay on the text track.

commands.name: marker.add
commands.description: Add a marker at a timeline time.

commands.name: playhead.seek
commands.description: Move the playhead to a timeline time.

commands.name: edit.undo
commands.description: Undo the last edit.

commands.name: edit.redo
commands.description: Redo the last undone edit.

commands.name: assist.silences
commands.description: Cut quiet stretches out of a clip (on this device). threshold in dBFS (default -40), minSilence seconds (default 0.6).

commands.name: assist.scenes
commands.description: Split a video clip where the picture changes sharply (on this device).

commands.name: assist.captions
commands.description: Write captions from the speech in a clip onto the Captions track, on this device (Whisper tiny). Works only after the person has downloaded the speech model.

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. en, hi, fr

commands.name: captions.srt
commands.description: Read the Captions track as SubRip (.srt) text.

commands.name: transcript.make
commands.description: Transcribe a clip's media into words on this device (Whisper tiny), so it can be edited by its words. Works only after the person has downloaded the speech model.

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. en, hi, fr

commands.name: transcript.read
commands.description: Read a clip's transcript as words [index, text, timeline seconds or null when the word is cut out]. Word times are estimates.

commands.name: transcript.cut
commands.description: Cut the words from index `from` to index `to` (inclusive, from transcript.read) out of the video; later clips close up.

clipId.description: A clip of the transcribed media

commands.name: assist.fillers
commands.description: Cut every filler word (um, uh, er, hmm) from a transcribed clip.

clipId.description: A clip of the transcribed media

commands.name: assist.duck
commands.description: Lower the music under the speech on the video tracks, as volume keyframes. clipIds: music clips to duck (default: every clip on an audio track). depth: the volume under speech as a fraction (default 0.25, about -12 dB).

commands.name: track.mix
commands.description: Set a track's gain (0-2, 1 is unchanged) and pan (-1 left to 1 right).

commands.name: captions.vtt
commands.description: Read the Captions track as WebVTT text.

commands.name: clip.freeze
commands.description: Freeze a video clip on the frame at a timeline time for a number of seconds; the clip splits there and later clips move along.

at.description: Timeline time of the frame, seconds

length.description: How long to hold it, seconds (default 2)

commands.name: assist.slideshow
commands.description: Turn the photos on the main track into a slideshow: each lasts `length` seconds, joined by a transition, with a slow zoom.

transition.description: crossfade, fade, wipe or slide (default crossfade)

zoom.description: End scale of the slow zoom, 1 for none (default 1.08)

commands.name: clip.detach_audio
commands.description: Give a video clip's sound its own clip on an audio track and mute the video clip, so the two can be edited apart.

commands.name: clip.slide
commands.description: Slide a clip between its neighbours by `by` seconds (positive is later); the neighbours give and take, the clip's content and the track length stay the same.

commands.name: clip.grade
commands.description: Colour-grade a video clip: lift, gamma and gain as [r, g, b] (lift -0.3..0.3, default 0; gamma and gain 0.5..2, default 1) and curve [shadows, midtones, highlights] output levels 0..1 (default [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]). Pass only what changes.

commands.name: clip.key
commands.description: Chroma key a clip (green screen): on, color (#rrggbb, default #00ff00), similarity 0..0.6, smoothness 0..0.4, spill 0..1.

similarity.description: How close a colour must be to vanish

spill.description: How much key colour to remove from edges

commands.name: captions.style
commands.description: Restyle every caption: clean, boxed, bold, pop.

commands.name: assist.autocut
commands.description: Find the beat of the music on the audio track and cut the main-track clips so each ends on a beat. every: cut every 1, 2 or 4 beats (default 2).

commands.name: clip.nest
commands.description: Put clips into a nest: one clip that plays them together, and a new item in the media bin. clipIds: the clips to nest.

commands.name: clip.unnest
commands.description: Put a full-length nest clip's clips back on the timeline.

commands.name: assist.clean
commands.description: Remove background noise from a clip's voice with RNNoise on this device; the clip's sound switches to a cleaned copy (a video clip's sound is detached first). Works only after the person has downloaded the noise model.

commands.name: assist.reframe
commands.description: Make the canvas 9:16 (or the aspect given) and pan a wide video clip to follow its subject, as x keyframes.

commands.name: assist.highlights
commands.description: Pick up to three highlights of about `seconds` from a transcribed clip with the NakliOS model, mark each, and set the I/O range to the best for a range export.

commands.name: assist.remove_background
commands.description: Cut the person out of a video or photo clip (MODNet on this device); put a background under it on a lower track. Works only after the person has downloaded the model.

commands.name: clip.duplicate
commands.description: Copy a clip and paste the copy at a time (seconds), on its own track or another of the same kind. On the main track the copy is inserted and the track closes up.

at.description: Where the copy starts, in seconds

trackId.description: Track for the copy (default: the clip's own track)

commands.name: range.mark
commands.description: Set the in and out marks (seconds) that a range export renders; pass null for either to clear it.

in.description: In mark, seconds, or null to clear

out.description: Out mark, seconds, or null to clear

commands.name: export.video
commands.description: Export the timeline to a file in the person's storage. preset: mp4-1080, mp4-720, mp4-4k, webm-1080, m4a / wav for the sound alone, or lossless to copy one untouched clip without re-encoding.

loudness.description: Normalise the sound to this many LUFS (for example -14), true peak under -1 dBTP
